title: 4D53006E-Forza_Motorsport.xiso.iso
queue_order: base, then sysmem; each request.sh --title, --device nova, --route survey, --seconds 420, --perflog, --expect this file
judge: python3 docs/lanes/flip474/phaseread.py --from 125 --to 240 <base> <sysmem>; lockread.py and gfpsseries.py on each over the same window; grep 'env: TU_DEBUG' in each logcat; crashcheck.py and tailcheck.py on each; the shots in the window, by eye
units: GPU, R and X as printed use limits.timestampPeriod; every leg is a ratio of two arms of one binary, or a CPU-clock time, so the period cancels.
prediction: DOA's fight on the Nova (NOTES.md section 16): GMEM executes the draw stream of its one heavy pass twice (X/R 0.99) and sysmem once (X/R 0.02); GPU 34.4 -> 19.6 printed, Tot 64 -> 41 ms, gfps 14 -> 21. X/R from runs on disk: AUF 1.01, Blinx 0.13, Forza 0.25. Forza's X/R is 0.25: a quarter of a replay, so a small gain at most from the render mode, and its frame is set by the deferred surface downloads (#414). The guess: GPU falls a little, gfps about equal.

legs.M0 (instrument): >= 15 hakuX-phase lines with GPU > 0 in the window in each arm, and the shots show play. Otherwise VOID for that arm, rerun once.
legs.E0 (the env reached the app): the sysmem arm's logcat has 'env: TU_DEBUG=sysmem' and the base has no TU_DEBUG line. Otherwise VOID.
legs.T0 (steady): the smallest gfps line in the window is >= 0.6 x the median, unless the shots show a scene change there. Otherwise VOID for that arm (thermal pause, section 15 of NOTES.md).
legs.H0 (no hang): each arm: longest gap between hakuX-perf lines in the window <= 3 s, lines to the end, no crash marker.
legs.S2 (GPU): sysmem's phase GPU median is 0.70 to 1.10 x the base's. Confidence 65%.
legs.L1 (no loss): sysmem's gfps median >= the base's - 1. Confidence 80%. KILL of a global sysmem policy: gfps median falls by 2 or more in a like scene, or GPU >= 1.25 x the base's.

expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures. The legs are read off hakuX-phase, hakuX-perf and the app's 'env:' lines.
